title: Native history log
description: What cst log --json prints in a native repository (CLI output; native/cli/src/native_log.rs, ADR-0047 decision 12): the commits the walk shows, in the order it shows them, each a native commit (docs/native-history/commits.md §3) by its native ID. Text members are UTF-8 as Git's --format prints the commit, an encoding such as ISO-8859-1 re-encoded and bytes that are not UTF-8 replaced; a member ending in Hex holds the stored bytes, in lowercase hex, exactly when they are not UTF-8.

nativeId.description: A native ID: the 64-character lowercase hex of its SHA-256 digest (ADR-0046, decision 5).

identity.description: An identity line, or null when the commit has none.

line.description: The identity line's value as Git prints it.

name.description: The name Git's split_ident_line finds, null when the line has no <email>.

email.description: The email, without its angle brackets, null when the line has none.

date.description: The date in ISO 8601 with its zone, as --date=iso-strict prints it, null when the line has no date or Git's log cannot print it.

lineHex.description: The line as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.

for.description: Whom an agent acts for; present only with kind agent.

type.description: Present in causet.show/v1, where an entry may be a tag.

encoding.description: The encoding the commit's message names, null for none.

changeId.description: The change identity lifted from the message (commits.md §5.3), null for none.

actors.description: The commit's commit-time actors (commits.md §2.2); an imported commit's are one authored actor, or none.

messageHex.description: The message as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.
